categories.main_business_segments: Beijing LongRuan Technologies Inc. primarily operates in intelligent mining industrial software and integrated information solutions. Its main business includes the development and provision of the LongRuan GIS platform, intelligent mining industrial software, smart safety supervision, emergency response systems, and smart city solutions. The company serves coal mining, non-coal mining, energy sectors, and government regulatory bodies with digital and intelligent mining solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include a proprietary LongRuan GIS platform with cloud GIS, 3D GIS, temporal GIS, and digital twin capabilities. It integrates advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, industrial internet of things, big data analytics, cloud computing, virtual reality, and spatial-temporal data processing. The production method focuses on software development with modular, service-oriented architecture and platform-based innovation, supporting multi-dimensional spatial data integration and intelligent mining control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large coal mining enterprises, government safety supervision agencies, emergency management departments, and industrial parks. The company’s products are widely used in coal mining safety production, intelligent mining operations, and government regulatory monitoring. It also serves non-coal mining, petroleum and natural gas industries, and high-risk sectors requiring safety and emergency management solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters in Beijing and regional centers covering major coal-producing provinces such as Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi, Xinjiang, Northeast China, and East China. It has begun international expansion efforts, targeting countries like Russia through partnerships with mining equipment manufacturers.
categories.supply_chain_position: LongRuan Technologies operates primarily in the midstream segment of the industrial software supply chain, focusing on software platform development, system integration, and technical services for intelligent mining and safety supervision. It also engages in hardware procurement for project implementation but does not manufacture mining equipment itself.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in intelligent mining technologies, focusing on enhancing the LongRuan GIS platform, digital twin mining systems, AI-driven safety monitoring, and cloud-based industrial internet solutions. R&D priorities include transparent geological assurance, intelligent mining control, smart ventilation, and emergency response systems. It invests heavily in patent development and collaborates with academic institutions to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of software products, customized technical services, system integration projects, and licensing of the LongRuan GIS platform. The company also earns income from hardware sales related to its integrated solutions and provides ongoing maintenance and support services. It follows a technology-driven, direct sales model with a focus on long-term client relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: LongRuan Technologies holds a leading position in the Chinese intelligent mining software industry, with a strong market share among top coal enterprises and government agencies. Its main competitors include other domestic industrial software providers and emerging technology firms in mining automation and safety. The company’s proprietary GIS platform and integrated solutions provide a competitive edge in terms of technology depth and industry-specific customization.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 396 million, an 8.56% increase over the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 84.3 million, up 5.39%. It maintains a solid financial position with total assets around RMB 902 million and net assets of RMB 719 million, showing steady growth and improving cash flow from operations. R&D investment accounted for over 11% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: LongRuan Technologies differentiates itself through its fully proprietary LongRuan GIS platform tailored for complex underground mining environments, offering integrated spatial-temporal data management and digital twin capabilities. Its solutions enable intelligent, transparent, and safe mining operations with real-time monitoring, predictive analytics, and automated control. The company’s deep industry expertise, extensive patent portfolio, and comprehensive service ecosystem provide customers with reliable, innovative, and scalable intelligent mining and safety supervision solutions.
